enabled.description: `Always` call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

destination.description: Destination for `Always` call forwarding. Required if field `enabled` is set to `true`.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the person's phone when a call has been forwarded.

sendToVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to voicemail when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.
